“茶城县双溪村出现特大雷暴，气象专家提醒，五月正值雷暴天气高发季节，户外活动需注意安全......”

“什么狗屁雷暴，明明是有道友在渡劫！”

“渡劫这么渡的？有没有点常识？那雷看着就是雷池的结构，搞不好是哪个道长在伐山破庙.....”

“我看着也像是五雷正法，就算不是伐山破庙也是斩妖驱邪。”

“卧槽，灵气复苏了？？”

“有没有战地记者啊，那边到底什么情况？”

“鬼知道，就算真有情况官方也封锁消息了，轮得到野生记者去看吗？”

“天地绝而复通，大道幽而复明，哇，这世界要变了......”

......

坐在陆巡的后座上，身心俱疲的林舒斜躺着刷着手机上的短视频。

这一轮雷暴、包括雷暴发生当时的影像都已经不可避免地泄露了出去，哪怕是官方也很难在这么短的时间内实时地做出应对。

自然而然地，好事的网友已经开始讨论----大部分人都是抱着看乐子的心态说什么“灵气复苏”啦、“仙人渡劫”啦、“伐山破庙”啦之类的东西。

其实他们自己都未必相信自己打出来的评论，只是为了吸引眼球，故意取乐罢了。

他们也根本不会想到，这些“玩笑”，其实距离事情的真相，已经非常近了......

“所以那具昆尸的遗骸，后续还有可能分析出什么东西吗？”

林舒坐直身子，一旁的霍清沉默着、不动声色地、但又略有些狗腿地顺手给他挪了挪靠枕。

“很难......一堆羟基磷灰石，烧得都快玉化了，基本没什么分析价值了......”

开车的陆染开口回答----这一次，她的车开得格外地稳。

“不过我们还是会尽快分析看看的，昆尸怎么也算未知生物了，组织上总会有人感兴趣......”

“嗯。”

林舒应了一声，转而问道：

“所以现在的舆论真的没有人去管管吗？视频都泄露出去了......”

“已经在处理了。”

秦朗快速操作着手中的平板，稍稍抬头回答道：

“视频泄露也是没办法的事情----这次的阵仗真的太大了。”

“两百公里外，临川市大猫山山顶都有人拍到这里的雷暴。”

“附近的村子就更不用说了，我们原本想着人员管控起来，让他们都在室内待着，基本上就不会有问题。”

“结果好了----他们确实没人看到、拍到我们结坛布阵的过程，但那雷是骗不了人的。”

“后续舆论引导还是要往极端天气上靠，正好，枪声也可以解释成人工驱雨作业。”

“不过......”

秦朗顿了一顿，突然话锋一转道：

“你这次算出了大风头了。”

“......这种风头我宁可不出。”

林舒翻了个白眼。

"A severe thunderstorm occurred in Shuangxi Village, Chacheng County. Meteorological experts reminded that May is the peak season for thunderstorms, so please pay attention to safety in outdoor activities..."

"What a bullshit thunderstorm, there are obviously fellow Taoists who are trying to overcome the tribulation!"

"This is how you overcome the tribulation? Do you have any common sense? That thunder looks like the structure of a thunder pool. Maybe some Taoist priest is cutting down mountains and destroying temples..."

"It looks like the Five Thunder Methods to me. Even if it's not cutting down mountains and destroying temples, it's still killing demons and exorcising evil spirits."

"Damn it, the spiritual energy has revived??"

"Are there any war reporters? What's going on over there?"

"Who knows, even if there is a real situation, the official has blocked the news. Will it be the turn of wild reporters to see it?"

"The sky and the earth are restored to normal, the great road is quiet and bright again, wow, the world is about to change..."

...

Sitting in the back seat of the Land Cruiser, Lin Shu, who was exhausted both physically and mentally, lay reclining and scrolled through short videos on his phone.

This round of thunderstorms, including the images at the time of the thunderstorms, have been inevitably leaked. It is difficult for even the authorities to respond in real time in such a short period of time.

Naturally, good-hearted netizens have already started discussing it - most of them are talking about things like "reviving spiritual energy", "immortals overcoming tribulations", "cutting down mountains and destroying temples", just for fun.

In fact, they themselves may not believe the comments they type, they are just trying to attract attention and deliberately have fun.

They would never have thought that these "jokes" were actually very close to the truth...

"So, is it possible to analyze anything from the remains of the corpse in the future?"

Lin Shu sat up straight, and Huo Qing beside him moved the pillow for him silently, calmly, but a little bit clumsily.

"It's very difficult... A pile of hydroxyapatite has almost turned into jade after being burned, and it has basically no analytical value..."

Lu Ran, who was driving, answered——This time, her car drove extraordinarily steadily.

"But we will still analyze it as soon as possible. Kun Zhi is still an unknown creature. There will always be people in the organization who are interested..."

"Yeah."

Lin Shu responded, then asked:

"So is it true that no one is taking care of public opinion now? The videos have all been leaked..."

"It's already being processed."

Qin Lang quickly operated the tablet in his hand, raised his head slightly and replied:

"There is nothing we can do about the video being leaked - this battle is really too big."

"Two hundred kilometers away, thunderstorms were photographed on the top of Damaoshan Mountain in Linchuan City."

"Not to mention the nearby villages. We originally thought that if we controlled the people and kept them indoors, there would basically be no problems."

"The result is good - indeed no one of them saw or photographed the process of us setting up the altar, but the thunder can't fool anyone."

"Follow-up public opinion guidance still needs to rely on extreme weather. It just so happens that the sound of gunfire can also be interpreted as artificial rain control operations."

"But..."

Qin Lang paused, then suddenly changed the topic:

"You've got the limelight this time."

"...I would rather not be in this kind of limelight."

Lin Shu rolled his eyes.
